subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS replace the dedicated Agent and Session pages with Home-based previous/next controls and standardize the new capability-gated Phone companion model-control contract?
rationale: The implementation is not a narrow defect repair: it changes the primary Wear navigation model and commits the companion protocol to a new supported capability surface, which requires owner product judgment.

options.title: Adopt the consolidated Home workflow
options.body: Approve the three-page navigation and capability-gated model controls, then require a rebase and exact-head Android/Wear compatibility refresh before merge.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Retain the existing Agent and Session pages and narrow any follow-up to improvements that do not alter the established Wear navigation model.

options.title: Defer the model-control contract
options.body: Accept Home placement for existing controls only and defer Phone-mediated model discovery and selection until its companion API direction is separately agreed.

recommendation.title: Adopt the consolidated Home workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the three-page navigation and capability-gated model controls, then require a rebase and exact-head Android/Wear compatibility refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-head hardening commit and PR assignment connect steipete directly to the affected Android/Wear design and compatibility path.
